newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Chinese mutineers sentenced to death in S.Korea. [CORRECTED 06:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chinese mutineers sentenced to death in S.Korea. [CORRECTED 06:25 GMT]

text.p: A South Korean court on Tuesday sentenced to death six mainland Chinese seamen of Korean descent for murdering the captain of a Korean fishing vessel and 10 (corrects from 11) other crew members, a court official said.
All six were sentenced in a court in South Korea's southern port city of Pusan.

The South Korean captain of the tuna fishing boat was murdered along with three (corrects from four) Indonesians, six other Koreans and an ethnic Korean Chinese in a mutiny in the South Pacific apparently sparked by harsh working conditions.
In addition to the mutineers, one South Korean navigator and six Indonesians survived the tragedy.
The bodies were dumped overboard by the mutineers and the crime came to light when the Pescamar No. 15 was found drifting without fuel south of Japan.
